verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a one-time-passcode generator (TOTP/HOTP) for 2-Step Verification. User-defined, event-triggered automation rules fall outside that product category, so this story does not apply. Nothing in the evidence suggests the app ships such a capability; its automatic code sync is a built-in behavior, not a rule a user defines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
